text: thats a cool mask, can u make it a toggle state or intensity slider
resolution: Both options delivered in the same landing (9883047a4): the depth hint has a toggle STATE (the 'depth hint' chip in the bench verb strip, twigged, figure targets only) AND an INTENSITY slider that appears next to the chip while the hint is on — a continuous 0..1 slide in the painter's own track visuals. The slider writes the P2 tunable through the tunables registry ('sculpt-camera.depthHint.opacity'), so the strip slider, the /settings 'depth hint α' knob, and the shader all read the one live table — no second opacity state anywhere. The slider's visuals get folded into the ONE kit slider when SCULPTKIT-0606's cohesion pass lands (noted in code).
